title: The webhook validates no Twilio signature, so anyone can mark the morning dose as taken
method: static read + live forged POSTs through the Flask test client
observed_at_discovery: Built the app with a CuraResponder wired to recording callbacks and posted with no X-Twilio-Signature header. POST /voice/checkin-response with Digits=1 returned HTTP 200 and fired on_medication_confirmed. Repeating it with a garbage signature header also returned 200 -- the header is never read. POST /voice/inbound with an arbitrary From returned the full greeting. grep for RequestValidator / X-Twilio-Signature over cura/comms/webhook.py: no matches. pytest exit 1: 1 failed of 3 without Flask (static half), 3 failed of 3 with Flask installed.
